# Nguyen Khai Tri Portfolio

> Nguyen Khai Tri is a Senior Performance Marketing Specialist in Ho Chi Minh City. His work connects paid acquisition, GA4/GTM tracking, CRM automation, data visualization and AI-assisted growth operations.

## Core pages
- [Profile and portfolio](https://khaitringuyen.com/): Career impact, selected systems, work history and skills.
- [Projects](https://khaitringuyen.com/projects/): Index of public case studies and live systems.
- [CV](https://khaitringuyen.com/View_CV.html): Detailed experience, capabilities and documented outcomes.
- [About](https://khaitringuyen.com/about.html): Background, positioning and working principles.
- [Articles](https://khaitringuyen.com/articles/): Practical notes about performance, data and automation.
- [Contact](https://khaitringuyen.com/contact.html): Direct contact options.

- [Knowledge Hub](https://khaitringuyen.com/knowledge/): Topic clusters and reading paths connecting performance marketing, CRM, AI automation, product systems and operations.
- [Portfolio search](https://khaitringuyen.com/search/): Client-side navigation utility for finding projects, articles, skills and systems.
- [Trung tâm kiến thức tiếng Việt](https://khaitringuyen.com/vi/knowledge/): Cụm chủ đề và lộ trình đọc bằng tiếng Việt.

## Selected projects
- [Hihie's Scent OS](https://khaitringuyen.com/projects/scent-os.html): Weather-aware fragrance wardrobe and layering system.
- [OpenClaw Intelligence](https://khaitringuyen.com/OpenClaw.html): Self-hosted market and advertising automation.
- [Mautic Lifecycle Automation](https://khaitringuyen.com/email_showcase.html): Segmentation, scoring and behavioral email journeys.
- [Interactive Data & Reports](https://khaitringuyen.com/data_analyze_visualize.html): Market research and sales pipeline dashboards.
- [Paid Media × Tracking × CRM](https://khaitringuyen.com/projects/performance-marketing-funnel.html): Full-funnel growth architecture.
